task.description:
Write a test specification and integration tests for PD-01 (Create definition) and PD-02 (Graph validation).

1. Write test spec at `tests/specs/PD-01-02.md` covering all acceptance criteria from both requirements.
2. Write integration test file at `tests/integration/definition_test.zig` that tests against a real PostgreSQL database using the TestHarness pattern from src/db/helpers.zig. Tests MUST NOT use SkipZigTest.

Required test cases:
- TC-PD-01-01: Create valid definition → HTTP 201, UUID assigned, status=DRAFT
- TC-PD-01-02: Create with same name+version → HTTP 409 (Conflict)
- TC-PD-01-03: Create with invalid graph (no START node) → rejected by graph validation
- TC-PD-01-04: Create with description omitted → allowed
- TC-PD-02-01: Valid graph (one START, one END, all edges valid) → passes
- TC-PD-02-02: Zero START nodes → HTTP 422 with violation identifying START issue
- TC-PD-02-03: Two START nodes → HTTP 422
- TC-PD-02-04: No END nodes → HTTP 422
- TC-PD-02-05: Dangling edge (references non-existent node) → HTTP 422
- TC-PD-02-06: Isolated node → HTTP 422
- TC-PD-02-07: Duplicate node ID → HTTP 422
- TC-PD-02-08: Non-gateway cycle → HTTP 422 with cycle path
- TC-PD-02-09: Cycle through EXCLUSIVE_GATEWAY → passes (allowed)
- TC-PD-02-10: node count > 500 → HTTP 422
- TC-PD-02-11: Multiple violations listed (not just first)

Existing unit tests in tests/unit/definition_test.zig already cover CHK-01..CHK-08 at unit level. The integration tests should verify the store.create() path end-to-end.

Validation: `zig build test` MUST exit 0.
acceptance_criteria: tests/specs/PD-01-02.md exists with all listed test cases

result.summary: Created tests/specs/PD-01-02.md with all 11 test cases (TC-PD-01-01..04, TC-PD-02-01..11). Created tests/integration/definition_test.zig with 11 integration tests using TestHarness pattern and no SkipZigTest. Updated src/bpm.zig to export definition module and tests/integration/main_test.zig to include the new file. Fixed pre-existing Zig 0.16 compile error in src/definition/store.zig (std.json.stringify → std.json.Stringify.valueAlloc). zig build test exits 0.

issues.description: Pre-existing compile error in src/definition/store.zig: std.json.stringify removed in Zig 0.16. Fixed by replacing with std.json.Stringify.valueAlloc.

result.next_action: Route to TEST-RUNNER (WF-02 Step 4) — run zig build test-integration with BPM_TEST_DB_URL set
